about: Round 34: strokes drawn with pressure as both phones build them (Freehand). factors: a point's width factor from a stylus's pressure (null: none, a finger) and its speed in page units a second: with a pressure, 0.35 + 0.65 x pressure (held to 0...1; 0 is the lightest touch, not none); else 1 - 0.65 x min(speed, 2000) / 2000; either to the hundredth, halves away from zero. outline: a line through points, half[i] out to each side at each, as a closed outline: each point pushed out along its normal, (ty, -tx) of the unit direction from the point before it to the point after (an end's, to or from its one neighbour) - the left of its way on a y-down page - or, where that way is nothing, the normal before it (straight up, (0, -1), at the start); the left edge (+) is M to its first point, a Q to each midpoint with the point as control, then L to its last point; A r r 0 0 1 (r the last half) round the end to the last right point; the right edge (-) back the same way; A r r 0 0 1 (r the first half) round the start to the first left point; Z. One point is a dot: M (x - r) y, A r r 0 1 1 (x + r) y, A r r 0 1 1 (x - r) y, Z. Numbers to the hundredth, halves away from zero, a whole one with no point. A stroke keeps one factor for each point its path is smoothed through (its samples), following both thinnings - in page units, then in its 0...100 box - and an eraser's pieces keep the factors of the points they keep.
